name: 大圖靠左＋右欄小圖與靠右文字
desc: 左側一張大的橫式圖片，右欄上方一張較小的橫式圖片，下方是靠右對齊的標題、說明文字與按鈕，兩欄之間留大片空白；區塊上下緣各有一條分隔線。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上緣與下緣各有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，分成左右兩欄，兩欄之間留大片空白，兩欄高度相當、垂直置中對齊：左欄放一張大的橫式圖片，約佔內容寬度的四成；右欄約佔內容寬度的三分之一，所有元素靠右對齊，由上而下是一張較小的橫式圖片（約佔右欄寬度的六成，明顯小於左側圖片）、標題（可多行）、說明文字，最下方可放按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，由上而下是大圖片、小圖片、標題、說明文字、按鈕；兩張圖片都放大到接近內容寬度，仍為橫式；標題、說明文字與按鈕維持靠右對齊；元素之間留大片空白。區塊上下緣的分隔線保留。

en.name: Large image left + right column with small image and right-aligned text
en.desc: A large landscape image on the left; the right column has a smaller landscape image on top and a right-aligned title, description and button below, with a wide empty space between the columns; a divider runs along the top and bottom edges of the section.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. A divider spanning the full viewport width runs along both the top edge and the bottom edge of the section. The content aligns to the page content width and is split into two columns with a wide empty space between them; the two columns are of similar height and vertically centered: the left column holds one large landscape image taking about four tenths of the content width; the right column takes about one third of the content width, with every element aligned right, and from top to bottom holds a smaller landscape image (about six tenths of the right column's width, clearly smaller than the left image), a title (may wrap to multiple lines), a description, and optionally a button at the bottom; omit it when there is no content.
en.mobile: Stacks vertically, from top to bottom: the large image, the small image, the title, the description and the button; both images grow to nearly the content width and stay landscape; the title, description and button stay aligned right; wide empty spaces separate the elements. The dividers along the top and bottom edges of the section remain.
